title: マヤノトップガン登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting from today, Mayano Top Gun will begin preparing for the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I organize a scrimmage to test her skills.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's time for takeoff! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay! ☆ I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… How did that… happen?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So you were being serious… when you said.. you had a new strategy…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haha! I thought it'd be interesting to be the front runner this time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But y'know… ☆ I think I just came up with a really fun way to run!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heehee. ♪ Like this!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Boom!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Are you sure you're not cheating? You have way too much energy…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (This is Nice Nature. She's quite close to Mayano Top Gun, so she's one of the racers who agreed to run in the scrimmage.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Don't you think that our twinkly, nerdy racer knows a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even now it looks like she's coming up with a whole new strategy…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …If there's some kind of trick to it, do you think you could spill it to me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's true that Mayano Top Gun tends to pick up on things very fast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that's her innate senses at work. Rather than a trick, it's more—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Argh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey! Trainer! Why aren't you looking at me?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh. Haha, my apologies. I was just borrowing your trainer for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What?! You can't do that! Trainer is mine!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That's it, no more running for the day! I refuse to do anything other than go on a date!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Don't "huh" me! This is all your fault!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: We'll rendezvous in ten minutes at the school gates! Do you copy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go get ready! See you in a bit. ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh my… It seems she's quite smitten with you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll be taking my leave now. You youngsters don't need someone like me in the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess Mayano Top Gun and I are going on a date now…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What are you gonna get, Trainer? I'm gonna get a super boiling hot one with honey whipped cream.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Drinks! C'mon, you can't walk down this street without a coffee in one hand!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Once we get to the next block, I'll let you have a sip of mine! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Come on! Try to look good for the camera, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Three, two, one!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you've gotta move. I'm taking a video, not a photo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My date with Mayano Top Gun continues…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Why are you walking so slow? Pick up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: All right, we're here! Our last spot for today.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's a racecourse, duh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The last stop on our date has to be the place where I twinkle the most!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, it looks like the next race is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the leaders round the fourth corner. Uh-oh, it looks like the racer in last place—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Did you see that cornering just now? I know what's gonna happen next!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haha, I knew it! She's gonna fake a pass and then stay on the ins—wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I didn't know you could maneuver like that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Incredible! That was amazing! Races really are the best way to get your heart pumping!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Look at them. I wanna race on a real track as soon as I can.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I wanna run and twinkle like those racers just now.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're right! My debut!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haha! ☆ You'll help me accomplish everything I want to do, won't you? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… I'm gonna race in the Twinkle Series! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm-hm-hmmm… I'm so excited. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And so, Mayano Top Gun and I begin our journey to take on the Twinkle Series.
